description: This file contains PowerPC assembly implementations of string manipulation functions such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, backwards_memcpy, memchr, and memcmp. It also includes routines for flushing cache for a range of addresses.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to n characters from source to destination.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates source string to the end of destination string.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to n characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specified value.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory blocks, handling overlapping regions.

methods.name: backwards_memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory blocks backwards, handling overlapping regions.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Searches for a character in a block of memory.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes data and instruction cache for a given address range.
